findings.title: Counter event history is not a Figure occurrence index
findings.finding: Set/Step are materialized in population. Filtered Func is deliberately skipped in postpass and evaluated by the demanded filtered fold. Replacing string keys with Selector::Element without a coherent read/finalization design leaves captions/references inconsistent with language counter reads. value_at_index counts all history records whereas layout idx counts Figure occurrences.
findings.required: Define demanded immutable histories and occurrence-to-Location lookup, including callback timing/error context/demand boundaries, or another measured coherent design. Never execute Func through the read-only trait or blindly fold unused keys.

findings.title: Supplement policy conflicts with current owner and is incomplete
findings.finding: Current references L0 excludes implicit supplement for filtered Element selectors; string helper treats known table/raw/image names as element supplements. Typed Name("table") cannot be passed through that helper as if it were Element(table). Draft does not specify exact custom-name error/absence behavior.
findings.required: Measure and specify focused typed Figure policy, explicit empty supplement precedence, numbering-none and reference behavior. Update reference/label/helper owners before code; do not silently reuse a legacy fallback.

findings.title: Compatibility adapter cannot certify semantic migration
findings.finding: Legacy Some("table") now means custom Name rather than inferred/native table. Synthetic data without resolved_kind also needs an explicit downstream policy. Current reconstruction using Content::figure would discard prepared state.
findings.required: Classify actual producers and fixture intent; preserve entire lexical/prepared state in maps and temporal reconstruction; define synthetic/unprepared payload boundary.

findings.title: Derived Rust Func equality/hash is not element identity proof
findings.finding: Rust native Func equality/hash compares names. Draft assumes validated canonical Element identity but does not make the validation/normalization boundary concrete. Deriving FigureKind PartialEq/Hash does not establish language acceptance for aliases/homonyms.
findings.required: Pin canonical element validation/normalization and ensure private progress/counter lookups use matching semantics; preserve alias and homonym negatives.

findings.title: Occurrence preparation and demand phase not ready for approval
findings.finding: The draft introduces a public entity/payload/trait compatibility change and pre-show preparation. Encoder is separately reviewing preview/final show-set ordering and semantic-field traversal. This bounded counter/client review does not certify that phase or complete affected graph.
findings.required: Keep V16-055 open. Finish owner graph and measured phase/effect policy in a separate gate package; prior Context occurrence approval does not authorize Figure.
